**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation in either direction:

- Targeted searches for MFN / "most favored" / "no less favorable" / best-price-matching language returned no hits.
- I read the full fee architecture (tiered per-ticket table p0059–p0063, Time of Payment, Record Keeping, Rebate Shares, and the Supplemental Payments provisions p0074–p0084), Article I definitions, and the General Provisions including the entire-agreement clause.
- The nearest analogue is p0078, the Supplemental Payments revenue share giving Licensor 33% of certain gross amounts we earn from third parties. That is a fixed profit-share on defined revenue streams — not an obligation to extend SFG the best terms we give any third party, and not a duty to match third-party offers — so it does not engage the MFN rule (and any pricing concerns there belong to a fee/revenue-share rule, not this one).

This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer). There is also no Vendor-granted MFN running in our favour, so there is nothing to preserve. Per the direction guidance, nothing here burdens us and no edit is warranted.
